title: Youth protest in Basel against rearmament and climate crisis
seoTitle: Basel youth protest rearmament and climate

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against rearmament, the climate crisis, and austerity measures affecting education.
tea.want: The protesters demanded action against rearmament and the climate crisis, and an end to education budget cuts.
tea.changed: Nov 20: Police in Basel used water cannons, rubber bullets, and tear gas after protesters erected barricades and attacked officers.

summary: On November 20, 2026, thousands of students and young people participated in protests across Switzerland, including in Basel, to voice opposition to rearmament, the climate crisis, and austerity measures in education. While many demonstrations remained peaceful, the event in Basel escalated after a permitted march. According to the Basel-Stadt cantonal police, a group of masked individuals constructed barricades using construction site fencing and trash containers. The police reported that officers were targeted with fireworks, bottles, pyrotechnics, and a slingshot. Authorities intervened using water cannons, rubber bullets, and tear gas to prevent further escalation. Similar protests occurred in other cities, including Zurich, Bern, Lausanne, Geneva, and Bellinzona, with varying levels of police interaction and reported attendance figures.
response: The Basel-Stadt cantonal police reported that they intervened to prevent escalation after protesters used barricades and attacked officers with fireworks, bottles, and pyrotechnics. Police utilized water cannons, rubber bullets, and tear gas.

crowd.text: Several hundred participants in the permitted march in Basel.

updates.text: Thousands of young people protest across Switzerland against rearmament, climate change, and education cuts.
In Basel, a permitted march turns into a confrontation with police involving barricades and projectiles.
Basel-Stadt police report using water cannons, rubber bullets, and tear gas to disperse protesters.
